messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Suspicious auth traffic detected for service account svcacct-proxy in prod-us-east-1. ~5k req/min, pattern of 401 -> retry -> 200. Possible credential replay. Pager severity: P1. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.local/alerts/2319 :rotating_light:

alex: Ack - I'm on it. Can someone grab the last 1h of auth logs and token issuance events?

lucas: pulling logs now. quick scan shows ~300k requests from 10.1.5.200-10.1.5.210. Many retries after initial 401. Token ids look like svc-p-***, repeated.

kira: joining - any signs of S3 or other data-plane access using same token?

maria: got one customer report of higher 429s ~20m ago in us-east. Might be related.

alex: running query now: ```kusto
AuthLogs | where timestamp > ago(1h) and service == "auth" and principal == "svcacct-proxy" | summarize count() by token_id, client_ip | sort by count_desc
```

lucas: results pasted: token_id svc-p-835 = 180k requests from 10.1.5.203. Issued at 2026-03-14T21:03:12Z. issuance source unclear.

kira: check IAM audit logs for token creation/issuance events and which host or CI action requested it. Also recommend revoking that token id immediately.

alex: running revoke: ```sh
authctl revoke --token svc-p-835
```
revoke response: OK - token svc-p-835 revoked.

lucas: applying edge ACL to block 10.1.5.200/29 at the WAF, starting terraform job now.

devops-bot: terraform apply started by lucas on infra/edge-waf (plan: add deny rule for 10.1.5.200/29). Run id: tf-run-9843.

lucas: ACL applied, initial telemetry showing ~95% drop in traffic from that CIDR. Still seeing retries and a handful of other IPs.

kira: treat this as compromised creds for now. Proposed plan: 1) revoke offending tokens (done), 2) rotate all active svcacct-proxy tokens, 3) rotate/rotate AWS IAM keys for role proxy-executor, 4) collect forensic snapshots for hosts that issued tokens. Maria, any customer comms?

maria: drafting a status notice for impacted customers. ETA 30m. Quick scan shows no confirmed PII exfil so far, will update.

alex: On-call handoff in ~40m. Emily can you take over the rotation/mitigation and keep the thread updated?

emily: I can take it. I'll start the rotation playbook and validate canaries.

kira: note - do not rotate primary keys for Dedicated customers without CS/Acct approval. Rotate short-lived service tokens first. We'll coordinate if we need to rotate broader credentials.

lucas: rotation script running: ```text
rotating svcacct-proxy tokens...
rotated 3 tokens
new token ids: svc-p-901, svc-p-902, svc-p-903
```

alex: confirm proxies picked up new tokens? Some proxies still presenting old tokens. We should allow a brief grace window then hard-reject old tokens.

devops-bot: scheduled job created to retire old tokens at 2026-03-14T22:15:00Z (job id retire-7231).

maria: initial status post published to status.redwood.com: "We are investigating elevated authentication traffic affecting a subset of services in us-east. Mitigation in progress." https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2026-03-auth-anomaly

kira: investigative checklist: collect host snapshots for 10.1.5.203 and any hosts that requested token issuance; preserve audit logs (auth/iam/build pipelines); open internal TIR: TIR-2026-042.

emily: taking over triage now. Will post updates every 15m or on significant events. Setting my on-call context. :thumbsup:

alex: TL;DR before I go: revoked svc-p-835, blocked offending CIDR, rotating tokens, forensic teams engaged, no confirmed data exfil at present. Security leads the investigation.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: Mitigation in progress -> Monitoring. Severity downgraded to P2 at 2026-03-14T22:42:15Z.

kira: post-incident action items: 1) rotate any remaining long-lived credentials for svcacct-proxy, 2) add anomaly detection rule for svcacct-proxy token issuance spikes, 3) review CI/build logs for accidental token disclosure, 4) update runbooks with fast-rotation steps.

emily: acknowledged. I'll file the follow-up ticket and schedule a 1hr postmortem sync tomorrow.

alex: leaving the handoff. Thanks team.
